dossier_name: Government e-Marketplace (GeM) National Portal Reverse Engineering Dossier

target_system.name: GeM National Public Procurement Portal
target_system.governing_body: Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India
target_system.description: Public reverse-engineering analysis detailing the complete architecture, DOM hierarchy, sub-domains, endpoints, and data contracts across gem.gov.in, mkp.gem.gov.in, and bidplus.gem.gov.in.

subdomains.purpose: National Public Procurement Portal Apex Gateway & Public Transparency Records
subdomains.public_access: Full public read access without authentication

key_endpoints.purpose: Portal home with tricolor header, language selector, dark mode, font scaler (A-, A, A+), national metrics
Public executed contracts registry with buyer department, supplier, order value, and CRAC acceptance date
Central Public Procurement Portal integration, state tenders, and national procurement datasets
One District One Product (ODOP) indigenous craft and agricultural listings across 750+ districts
Statutory advantages for MSEs, startups, and women entrepreneurs under Public Procurement Policy
Comprehensive FAQ directory for Buyers, Primary Users, Consignees, and Sellers
Document help, incident management manuals, and video walkthroughs
Toll-free helpdesk numbers (1800-419-3436, 1800-102-3436) and regional nodal offices

subdomains.purpose: Public Marketplace Catalog, Product & Service Taxonomy, and Registration Gateway
subdomains.public_access: Full public catalog browsing without authentication; login required only for Cart checkout & Seller listing

key_endpoints.purpose: Catalog full-text search across 10,917+ products and services
Full category taxonomy hierarchy
Trending & Emerging Services catalog with service level agreements (SLAs)
Buyer registration portal requiring government email verification (@nic.in, @gov.in)
Seller onboarding portal with PAN, Aadhaar, and Udyam MSME verification

subdomains.purpose: Public Tenders, Bidding Engine, and Reverse Auction Monitoring
subdomains.public_access: All bid notices, BOQ specifications, corrigenda, and PDF documents are public without login

key_endpoints.purpose: Live public bids stream establishing CSRF session cookie `csrf_bd_gem_nk`
Paginated public Solr query endpoint returning active tenders, quantities, and consignees
Multi-attribute filter: Ministry, State, Department, Tender Value, Due Date
Published evaluation results, disqualified technical bids, L1 ranks, and award contracts
Direct official PDF tender notice containing technical specifications and terms

subdomains.purpose: Government E-Scrap, Condemned Vehicles & Surplus Property Disposal
subdomains.public_access: Public lot inspection and auction schedule browsing without login

key_endpoints.purpose: Live ongoing forward auctions directory across all departments
Forward auction buyer/bidder registration guidelines

subdomains.public_access: Public read access for Zonal Railways procurement tenders and supply contracts

key_endpoints.purpose: Public railway tenders and high-capacity freight procurement
Railway Purchase Orders and awarded supply contracts

subdomains.purpose: Proprietary Best Price (PBP) Notices and Single-Source Procurement
subdomains.public_access: Public PBP notices browsing without login

key_endpoints.purpose: PBP notice directory and PAC (Proprietary Article Certificate) justifications

subdomains.purpose: GeM Learning Management System (LMS) Interactive Training
subdomains.public_access: Public catalog of interactive courses, webinars, and certification syllabi

key_endpoints.purpose: Training modules for Buyers (Primary Users, HODs, Consignees) and Sellers (OEMs, Resellers)

gfr_rule_149.direct_purchase_rule: Available for goods/services meeting quality specifications up to ₹50,000 without price comparison.
gfr_rule_149.l1_comparison_rule: Comparison between at least 3 distinct OEMs/manufacturers meeting required specifications to identify L1 price.
gfr_rule_149.mandatory_bidding_rule: Mandatory online competitive bidding or reverse auction (RA) on bidplus.gem.gov.in.
